text: The Inward Craft is a US-focused hybrid series mixing mystical fiction with practical integration. Every volume keeps 70% narrative and 30% rituals/reflections, with 280-320 pages and a trauma-aware tone.
Primary magic law: external magical outcomes scale with unresolved internal patterns. Shortcut power obtained through denial always creates energetic debt paid in later chapters or books.
Mara Voss evolves from pattern-survival to embodied sovereignty across 10 books. Each ending closes one wound loop and opens one deeper layer of responsibility.
Narrative voice is intimate and psychologically grounded. Never promise instant healing, never shame the reader, never present rigid guru authority.
Book 1 targets readers searching: shadow work for beginners. Query intent: I want to understand my shadow self without therapy.
Book 2 targets readers searching: ancestral healing rituals. Query intent: How do I stop repeating family emotional cycles?
Book 3 targets readers searching: personal grimoire guide. Query intent: I need a spiritual practice that actually fits my life.
Book 4 targets readers searching: manifestation and nervous system. Query intent: Manifestation is not working and I think trauma is the block.
Book 5 targets readers searching: dark night of the soul spiritual. Query intent: I am losing myself during awakening and need a map.
Book 6 targets readers searching: sigil magic healing. Query intent: I need practical symbolic rituals that feel emotionally real.
Book 7 targets readers searching: somatic healing spiritual practice. Query intent: What spiritual practices help anxiety and body tension?
Book 8 targets readers searching: nature spirituality eco mysticism. Query intent: I want a spiritual path connected to nature and cycles.
Book 9 targets readers searching: shadow integration Jungian. Query intent: How do I integrate my shadow without losing myself?
Book 10 targets readers searching: spiritual sovereignty women. Query intent: I want to trust my own spiritual authority.
Validation-first launch: prioritize Book 3 or Book 4 as first standalone Kindle release to test lower-saturation demand before full series rollout.
Collector physical strategy includes colored edges, thematic bookmarks, and playlist QR codes to turn the book into a ritual object and increase perceived value.
